name: Stray Strut
body:
When the companion or familiar can use Stray Gambit without a command.

Prerequisites: Companion or Familiar level 7th, Stray Gambit

Benefit(s): You are able to exercise a degree of independence when on your own that allows you to pass yourself off as a stray animal. Even when not instructed by your master, you may use the Stray Gambit feat but you take a -5 penalty if you didn’t receive a command to use the feat.
